name.zh: CTExcel 英国（中国电信欧洲）

tagline.en: China Telecom's EE line: China-UK shared data from £4.90, 180 days to keep the number
tagline.zh: 中国电信走 EE 网络的英国卡，中英共享流量 4.9 镑起，180 天内用一次就保号

description.en: CTExcel UK is China Telecom (Europe)'s UK mobile brand, an MVNO on EE aimed at Chinese students and UK-China commuters. Two tariff families run on the same SIM: 30-day rolling bundles (UK 3GB £4.90; China-UK shared 22GB £9.90, 50GB £11.90, 120GB £14.90, 300GB £19.90; unlimited £29.90) and 180-day return-China packs (30GB £22, 50GB £28, promo prices as of 2026-09). One card carries a UK number plus a Chinese secondary number; Wi-Fi Calling makes calls to 15 international destinations including mainland China unlimited. Keep the number with any charged usage: the FAQ sets 180 days, the 30-day rolling product pages say 90. First activation must happen in the UK or EU, with usage within 10 days.
description.zh: CTExcel UK 是中国电信（欧洲）旗下英国移动品牌，走 EE 网络的虚商，面向留学生与中英往返人群。同一张卡上并行两套资费：30 天滚动包（英国 3GB 4.90 镑；中英共享 22GB 9.90、50GB 11.90、120GB 14.90、300GB 19.90 镑；无限量 29.90 镑）与 180 天回国包（30GB 22 镑、50GB 28 镑，价格为 2026-09 促销价）。一卡双号，英国号码加中国副号；开 Wi-Fi Calling 后拨打含中国大陆在内 15 个方向不限量。保号靠任意计费使用：官方 FAQ 写 180 天，30 天滚动档的产品页写 90 天。首次激活须在英国或欧盟完成，激活后 10 天内需有使用记录。

details.en:
CTExcel UK is the China Telecom counterpart to CMLink's China Mobile lineage. Both are EE MVNOs selling a UK number plus a Chinese secondary number, so the choice comes down to price per GB back to China, keep-alive cost, 5G and where the traffic lands.

On price it wins. The 30-day rolling list (2026-09): UK-only 3GB £4.90; China-UK shared 22GB £9.90, 50GB £11.90, 120GB £14.90, 300GB £19.90, with the 300GB tier adding 20GB of EU roaming; unlimited £29.90 (£23.90 on promo) carrying 300GB in China plus 30GB in the UK/EU. Everything from £11.90 up includes 200 UK minutes to 15 international destinations including China. For longer trips the China-return tab sells 180-day packs: 30GB for £22 (was £36) and 50GB for £28 (was £40). The 365-day annual bundles were delisted in 2026-09.

Opening cost is the lowest of the China-operator UK lines: the freecard campaign hands out the SIM free, and ordering a bundle at claim time waives the £1 pre-load. Community reports say no real-name check is required, which is unofficial and may change. eSIM is supported again, with physical-to-eSIM conversion quoted at £3 by community sources. Port-in works.

The keep-alive rules are the one place to read carefully, because the two tariff families disagree. The official FAQ says any charged activity within 180 days resets the clock, and texting BAL to 888 for a balance check already counts, so the line can be parked for nothing. The 30-day rolling bundles are documented separately as auto-cancelling after 90 days without use. Numbers terminated for inactivity cannot be reactivated, and a warning SMS arrives around day 60. Bundles renew per 30 days; when data runs out you can still receive SMS without topping up.

Roaming covers 34 countries, 4G only, no 5G anywhere. Like CMLink, activation has to happen in the UK or EU (CTExcel excludes Hong Kong) with usage in the first 10 days. The roaming exit is a clean native UK IP, so TikTok and Telegram register without trouble. Stability is rated below CMLink by community users, and a throttling rumour circulates without confirmation.

Verdict: the cheapest way into a China-UK line and the most forgiving to park, at the cost of 5G and some polish.
details.zh:
CTExcel UK 与 CMLink 分属电信、移动两大系。两家都是 EE 虚商，都卖英国号码加中国副号，真正的差别在回国流量单价、保号成本、5G 和落地 IP。

价格这一项它占优。30 天滚动资费（2026-09）：英国本地 3GB 4.90 镑；中英共享 22GB 9.90、50GB 11.90、120GB 14.90、300GB 19.90 镑，300GB 档另含 20GB 欧洲漫游；无限量 29.90 镑（促销 23.90），含 300GB 中国流量加 30GB 英国/欧盟。11.90 镑及以上套餐都带 200 分钟英国本地拨打，可打含中国在内 15 个方向。时间更长的话，回国套餐页卖 180 天包：30GB 22 镑（原价 36）、50GB 28 镑（原价 40）。365 天年包已于 2026-09 下架。

开卡成本是华人英国卡里最低的：freecard 活动免费寄卡，领卡时同时订购套餐再免 1 镑预充。社区口径称无需实名，这属于非官方信息，随时可能变。eSIM 已重新开放，社区称实体卡转 eSIM 收 3 镑。支持携号转网。

保号规则要看清，因为两套资费的口径不一样。官方 FAQ 写的是 180 天内任意一次计费行为即可续期，给 888 发 BAL 查余额就算，所以这张卡可以零成本挂着。30 天滚动档的产品页另注明 90 天无使用自动销号。因长期不活跃被停机的号码无法恢复，约第 60 天会收到提醒短信。套餐按 30 天滚动续订；流量用完后不续费仍能收短信。

漫游覆盖 34 个国家，只有 4G，全系没有 5G。与 CMLink 一样须在英国或欧盟首次激活（CTExcel 不含香港），且激活后 10 天内要有使用记录。漫游出口是干净的英国原生 IP，注册 TikTok、Telegram 都正常。社区用户对稳定性的评价低于 CMLink，另有「后续限速」的传闻至今没有证实。

结论：进中英电话卡这个坑最便宜的选择，挂着也最省事，代价是没有 5G、打磨程度差一点。

plansNote.en: Prices checked 2026-09-25 on the CTExcel UK storefront: 30-day rolling bundles from the plan list, 180-day packs from the China-return tab (365-day annual bundles delisted). Keep-alive wording differs between the FAQ (180 days) and the 30-day bundle pages (90 days); confirm on the plan you buy. The eSIM conversion fee and the no-KYC claim are community reports.
plansNote.zh: 价格于 2026-09-25 在 CTExcel 英国官网核验：30 天滚动包取自套餐列表，180 天包取自回国套餐页（365 天年包已下架）。保号口径在 FAQ（180 天）与 30 天档页面（90 天）之间不一致，请按所购套餐页确认。eSIM 转换费与免实名为社区口径。

country.en: GB in the UK via EE; China-roaming landing unverified
country.zh: 在英国为 GB（走 EE）；内地漫游落地未核实

note.en: China Telecom (Europe) MVNO on EE UK, confirmed by an ISPreview hands-on. Community reports say the UK IP is clean; Reddit users pair it with a residential-IP VPN when using it in China, which implies the stock exit is a standard EE mobile IP. No public IP-country test of China roaming was found.
note.zh: 中国电信（欧洲）的 EE 网 MVNO，ISPreview 实测确认。社区称英国 IP 纯净；Reddit 用户在中国使用时还需另配住宅 IP 的 VPN，说明默认出口就是普通 EE 移动 IP。中国漫游的落地国家没有查到公开实测。
